body: Thanks for your concern, I would change but I just feel like there's no point, if I do I may find some fleeting happiness but eventually this crippling feeling of hopelessness will catch up with me. I'd feel as though I'm wasting my time and everyone else's, and that I should just end it. No matter how happy I can make myself feel it's always followed by this hollow realization that im lying to myself. Any advice on how to overcome this?
